question: Which recipients must be worshiped sequentially according to the cited instruction?
premises: The earth-lord and earth-owner are named as recipients.
A man is also included as a recipient.
The acts of worship and honoring are to be done in order.
inference: The ritual requires sequential worship of the earth-lord, the earth-owner, and the man.
uncertainties: Whether bhū+patim and bhūmi+svāminam denote distinct figures or the same figure is not explicit.
plain_english: One should worship in order the lord of the earth, the owner of the earth, and the man.
